title: AI-Mediated Hiring and the Job Search of Blind and Low-Vision Individuals
reasoning: The paper is an empirical qualitative study focusing on human-computer interaction and digital accessibility for blind and low-vision (BLV) job seekers. While it discusses fairness and the dehumanizing nature of algorithmic rejection, it does not have a component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
